ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ( ( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Approval") && !ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Proposal") ) || ( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Ready to close") && !ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Approval") ) || ( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") && !OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Ready to close") ) ) ) && ISCHANGED(StageName) && $Profile.Name != "Desktop Integration" && $Profile.Name != "System Administrator" && !$Permission.DMT_Line_God && !DMT_Cancel__c && DMT_RecordTypeName__c == "DMT Opportunity"
ValidationRule.errorMessage: It is mandatory to go through all the states of the opportunity in the indicated order.
